item.title: AFCON: Former Nigeria coach, Troussier names eight countries that can win trophy
item.description: Former Nigeria coach, Philippe Troussier has named eight teams that can win the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations, AFCON, which kicks off in Morocco on Sunday night. item.title: AFCON 2025: CAF appoints Mauritanian referee for Super Eagles vs Tanzania
item.description: The Confederation of African Football, CAF, has appointed Mauritania’s Dahane Beida as centre referee for the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations Group C encounter between Nigeria and Tanzania, DAILY POST reports. Beida is one of the experienced referees in Africa. The arbiter was in charge of Video Assistant Referee, VAR, during AFCON 2025’s opening game […] AFCON 2025: CAF appoints Mauritanian referee for Super Eagles vs Tanzania

item.title: US Ambassador explains visa restrictions on Nigerians
item.description: United States Ambassador to Nigeria, Richard Mills, has clarified the rationale behind the recent visa restrictions imposed on Nigerians, emphasizing that the measures are part of broader security protocols rather than targeted actions against Nigerian citizens. Speaking at a press briefing on Sunday in Abuja during the visit of a U.S. Congressional Delegation, CODEL, Mills […] US Ambassador explains visa restrictions on Nigerians

item.title: Afenifere chieftain, Opadokun identifies those sponsoring terrorism in Nigeria
item.description: Former Secretary-General of Afenifere, Ayo Opadokun, has said that those who do not want the current government to succeed are responsible for the lingering insecurity. item.title: Kogi Poly sacks lecturer over alleged sexual misconduct
item.description: Kogi State Polytechnic has terminated the appointment of a lecturer named Mukhtar Muhammed over alleged sexual misconduct involving a student. The institution also dismissed another staff member, Funmilayo Afolabi for prolonged absence from duty, having allegedly stayed away from work for nine months. The decisions were disclosed in a statement issued on Sunday by […] Kogi Poly sacks lecturer over alleged sexual misconduct

item.title: One killed, five abducted in fresh bandit attack in Zamfara
item.description: Suspected bandits on Saturday night attacked Fananawa village in Bukuyum Local Government Area of Zamfara State, killing one person and abducting five residents. The Zamfara State Police Command confirmed the incident, saying one person was killed, another injured and five others abducted during the attack. The spokesperson of the command, DSP Yazid Abubakar, […] One killed, five abducted in fresh bandit attack in Zamfara

item.title: Over 100 APC supporters dump party for ADC in Kebbi
item.description: No fewer than hundred thousand supporters of the All Progressives Congress, APC, in Lega Local Government Area of Kebbi State have dumped the party. The APC supporters joined the African Democratic Congress, ADC, in a mega defection rally held at the weekend. According to ADC mobilization X handle, the defectors were over 120,000. DAILY POST […] Over 100 APC supporters dump party for ADC in Kebbi

item.title: Yuletide: Osun NSCDC deploys 1700 personnel, tightens security
item.description: Osun State Command of the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps, NSCDC, has deployed 1700 personnel in anticipation of influx of visitors into the state during the Yuletide season. The deployment is also to ensure the safety of lives and adequate protection of critical national assets and infrastructure across the state. item.title: Tinubu cautions Nigerians against alcohol, vows to defeat bandits, terrorism
item.description: As Nigerians head into 2026, President Bola Tinubu has declared his administration would defeat banditry and terrorism in the country. This was as Tinubu warned Nigerians against the intake of alcohol and becoming endangered to anybody’s life during the Yuletide season.
